row_source_locator.source_label: Equation (1.3): q(x,t) = qtilde(x - ubar t) solves the advection equation and propagates unchanged

source_contract.statement: For a real constant speed and scalar profile, q(x,t)=profile(x-speed*t) propagates the profile unchanged; if the profile is differentiable on R, q is a global classical solution of q_t + speed q_x = 0.
assumptions: The speed is a constant real scalar with no sign or nonzero restriction.
Classical PDE satisfaction is asserted under global differentiability of the profile; rigid propagation itself requires no regularity.
quantifiers: For every profile : R -> R and speed : R.
For all x,t : R in both the characteristic identity and global pointwise PDE predicate.
